SELECT o.*, ar.area_code AS areaCode, ar.area_name AS areaName, g.grid_code AS gridCode, g.grid_name AS gridName, u1.user_name AS approvalName, u2.user_name AS createName, u3.user_name AS updateName FROM outdoor_ad o LEFT JOIN sys_area ar ON o.area_id = ar.id LEFT JOIN sys_grid g ON o.grid_id = g.id LEFT JOIN sys_user u1 ON o.approval_by = u1.id LEFT JOIN sys_user u2 ON o.creator = u2.id LEFT JOIN sys_user u3 ON o.updater = u3.id
ORDER BY o.create_time DESC

SELECT o.*, ar.area_code AS areaCode, ar.area_name AS areaName, g.grid_code AS gridCode, g.grid_name AS gridName, u1.user_name AS approvalName, af.file_url AS fileUrl, af.file_name AS fileName, af.file_type AS fileType, u2.user_name AS createName, u3.user_name AS updateName FROM outdoor_ad o LEFT JOIN sys_area ar ON o.area_id = ar.id LEFT JOIN sys_grid g ON o.grid_id = g.id LEFT JOIN sys_user u1 ON o.approval_by = u1.id LEFT JOIN sys_attach_file af ON o.attach_file_id = af.id LEFT JOIN sys_user u2 ON o.creator = u2.id LEFT JOIN sys_user u3 ON o.updater = u3.id WHERE o.id = #{reqVO.id}
